label: NTP
notes: NTPv4 control message header per RFC 5905 section 7.3 (Figure 8) on UDP port 123. Byte 0 is one bit-packed word carrying three masked views (leap indicator, version, mode); every field of the 48-byte fixed header is either a view or a reasoned exclusion. The four 64-bit timestamps are twice the 4-byte BPF load window and cannot be matched with an equality clause, so server-selection fields are not filterable. Mode 6 (control, the ntpq protocol) and mode 7 (private) messages share the port and the first 48 bytes; NTP extension fields (RFC 7822) follow the header in symmetric/client/server modes with variable length and stay outside the filter window. The Reference ID is modelled as one raw 32-bit word: a four-character clock code for stratum 1 (e.g. 0x47505320 "GPS "), the sync source's IPv4 address for strata 2-15 and a kiss code for stratum 0. SNTP (RFC 4330) uses the same layout.

fields.label: Leap Indicator
fields.description: Top two bits of byte 0; 3 means the server clock is unsynchronized and its time must not be used.

fields.label: Version
fields.description: Middle three bits of byte 0; NTPv4 per RFC 5905, NTPv3 per RFC 1305.

fields.label: Mode
fields.description: Low three bits of byte 0; the client/server pair (3/4) carries ordinary time queries, 1/2 peer synchronization and 5 broadcast.

fields.label: Stratum
fields.description: 0 unspecified (kiss code in the Reference ID), 1 primary reference, 2-15 secondary via NTP hops, 16 unsynchronized, 17-255 reserved.

fields.label: Poll Interval
fields.description: Signed base-2 logarithm of the polling interval in seconds (typically 4 to 17, e.g. 10 = 1024 s); negative values read as their two's-complement byte (e.g. -6 = 250).

fields.label: Precision
fields.description: Signed base-2 logarithm of the system clock precision in seconds (e.g. 0xfa = -6, about 15.6 microseconds); stored as the two's-complement byte.

fields.label: Root Delay
fields.description: Total round-trip delay to the reference clock as a 16.16 fixed-point seconds word (0x00018000 = 1.5 s); matched as the raw wire word.

fields.label: Root Dispersion
fields.description: Maximum error relative to the reference clock as a 16.16 fixed-point seconds word; matched as the raw wire word.

fields.label: Reference ID
fields.description: Stratum 1: a four-character clock source code (0x47505320 = "GPS ", 0x474e5353 = "GNSS"); strata 2-15: the sync source's IPv4 address as a 32-bit word; stratum 0: a kiss code (e.g. 0x52415445 = "RATE").

excluded.reason: 64-bit Reference Timestamp (seconds + fraction per RFC 5905 §7.3); twice the 4-byte BPF load window, so no exact equality clause exists
64-bit Originate Timestamp (packet time at the client); twice the 4-byte BPF load window
64-bit Receive Timestamp (packet time at the server); twice the 4-byte BPF load window
64-bit Transmit Timestamp (packet departure time); twice the 4-byte BPF load window
